version_policy.upgrade_lifecycle: source_version must be lower than target_version
version_policy.other_triggers: source_version may equal target_version only for a selected remediation record; source_version greater than target_version is rejected
version_policy.unknown_version: an absent observed version is accepted only when the agent independently confirms the Mautic major, the active catalog explicitly allows unknown versions for the selected record, and all vulnerable source-signature gates match; otherwise return blocked/noop without mutation
version_policy.authority: MCC selects applicability from the active effective catalog; MCD independently validates the returned version relation and never supplies version-specific fallback

request_operation_semantics: operation is required and must be one of status, verify, apply, rollback; run_id is required for rollback and optional for other operations; target_version is optional for non-upgrade triggers and MCC resolves it to the observed version
dependency_resolution: MCC returns the effective selected records in validated dependency and phase_order order; MCD does not independently select IDs or infer dependencies

payload_contract.git_patch_v1: bounded UTF-8 or Git-binary patch bytes in payloads with exact SHA-256; paths must be declared, relative, root-contained, and symlink-safe; deletion and rename are rejected
payload_contract.db_json_normalize_v1: typed declarative parameters only; no SQL, shell, PHP, or executable text; the agent validates identifiers and schema and executes only its fixed implementation

db_json_normalize_v1_parameters.identifier_validation: table and column must match the agent's strict identifier grammar and exist in the selected instance schema; values are parameter-bound
db_json_normalize_v1_parameters.rollback: persist row keys and original values; restore a row only if its current column value still equals the recorded replacement; otherwise fail closed

plugin_reload_retry_semantics: before each plugin reload, run the catalog-selected db_json_normalize_v1 capability at most once when the instance database and declared column exist; if and only if reload fails with the exact plugin_update_metadata_array_null signature, run the same normalization once more and retry reload once; missing database/column means skip, and other errors are never retried
m6_runtime_remediation_semantics: the daemon retains its current planning-cycle cadence; when observed_version is unknown, it may request a catalog-selected remediation only after independently confirming observed_major=6, and only the selected record may permit unknown version; the vulnerable source-signature gates still decide whether apply is safe
legacy_state_import_semantics: when current source matches fixed gates, the agent may recognize a pre-v3 backup only through the selected record's declared legacy_state descriptor; it verifies declared relative paths, metadata marker/path fields when present, backup original SHA, current patched SHA, and vulnerable/fixed gates. Read-only status reports validated legacy rollback availability without writing. Apply or rollback may atomically import the snapshot into the generic ledger. Any mismatch fails closed; no legacy filename, marker, or patch ID is hardcoded in the executor.

legacy_state_descriptor_semantics.suffixes: suffixes are appended to the declared source path basename; they must be simple dot-prefixed filename suffixes with no slash, backslash, or parent traversal
legacy_state_descriptor_semantics.backup_file: metadata_suffix and expected_marker are null and metadata_fields is empty; both backup bytes and current bytes must independently satisfy the selected record vulnerable/fixed gates
legacy_state_descriptor_semantics.backup_file_with_metadata: metadata_suffix is required; metadata_fields maps semantic names marker, path, original_sha256, applied_sha256 to JSON object keys; expected_marker is a catalog value; source path, marker, original hash, applied hash, and both vulnerable/fixed gates must match
legacy_state_descriptor_semantics.plan_presence: legacy_state is returned on every selected record that declares it, including status and rollback plans; MCD never infers a descriptor from a patch ID or local filename

status_semantics: read-only; evaluate selected-record gates and report already-correct, candidate, ambiguous, or blocked without writing files or database rows
verify_semantics: read-only; validate the immutable selected plan, payload hashes, paths, source gates, and applicable patch preconditions without mutation
apply_semantics: idempotent; atomically apply the selected phase; already-correct state is a no-op; partial, mixed, unknown, stale, unsafe-path, or payload-integrity state fails closed
rollback_semantics: bound to run_id and the persisted immutable plan/hash; restore original bytes, mode, uid, and gid or remove a created file only if its current SHA-256 equals the recorded after SHA-256; database rows restore only when their current value equals the recorded replacement; drift is never overwritten
phase_atomicity: runtime invocation is atomic per phase; upgrade preflight remains atomic across its declared internal phases; lifecycle phases are invoked separately by their owning workflow
evidence_integrity: MCC verifies the authenticated host owns instance_uid and verifies registry, catalog, and plan hashes before recording evidence
host_identity: MCD sends its configured mcc_host_name and hostname; it never supplies MCC Host.id. MCC resolves host identity server-side, returns the derived host_id in the resolve response, and requires that UUID together with the host names on evidence submission.
cache_semantics: catalog bytes are not an MCD source of truth; a cache hint is only catalog_revision plus catalog_sha256; a stale or unknown hint returns a complete immutable selected plan
